findings.message: public.active_users exists, and there is no record of this project having applied its definition
findings.reason: definition drift is detected by comparing what PostgreSQL made of the definition when a migration applied it against what it says now. Without the first of those there is nothing to compare, so the body of this relation is unverified — it may be the declared one, and nothing here can tell
findings.fix: apply public.active_users through a migration so its definition is recorded. Until then its body is not checked
